review: Independent model review of the complete candidate inventory for current, common standalone regional starter-answer suitability; not native-human certification. This is answer selection and source-sense ordering, not a verification of every broader dictionary gloss.
method: Reviewed the combined word/qualifying-sense inventory, inspected ambiguous forms, names, regional contrasts and all folded collisions. Approvals require the existing pinned regional membership and qualifying source sense. No missing meanings were invented. Common independent nouns, adjectives, infinitives, function words and interjections can qualify; explicitly inflection-only and unresolved spelling-reference readings cannot. Independent lexical plural-only férias is retained, unlike ordinary family plurals pais/filhos.
